disclosure: This uploads your sequences and input files to subseq.bio under your own subseq account. subseq.bio bills each job against that account's credits using per-program rates and a submit fee; DNAForge does not charge for it. Read subseq.bio's terms before connecting.
retentionNote: Results are downloadable as a ZIP or per file from the job record; retention period is not published. Import results promptly.

cancellation.note: subseq.bio can cancel queued or running jobs through its hosted job API.
